trial_court: Principal Senior Civil Judge's Court, Rajampet, HMOP.No.39 of 2017
case_name: Basetty Venkata Pradeep Kumar vs Basetty Gnana Deepthi Alias S.Gnana
facts_of_case: The respondent filed for divorce on the ground of cruelty. The petitioner failed to cross-examine the respondent and adduce evidence. A decree was passed in favor of the respondent. The petitioner then filed an application to condone the delay in presenting a petition to set aside the ex parte decree.

legal_principles.principle: A petition filed under Order IX Rule 13 CPC is not maintainable if the petitioner ought to have preferred an appeal against the orders of the trial Court.
legal_principles.held: The petition under Order IX Rule 13 CPC is not maintainable. The petitioner ought to have preferred an appeal against the orders of the trial Court but filing a petition under Order IX Rule 13 CPC is not maintainable.
applicable_acts_sections: Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 — Order IX Rule 13

legal_principles.principle: A petition filed after the expiry of the appeal period is not maintainable.
legal_principles.held: After getting knowledge of the same, the petitioner filed this petition only in order to harass and extract more money from the respondent. The petition is devoid of merits and liable to be dismissed as the petition is not maintainable being void ab initio.

outcome.final_order: The trial court's order allowing the petition to condone the delay was upheld.
